response.justification: The candidate lacks the required 8 years of C++ experience and 5 years of large-scale infrastructure/cloud compute platform design, with most roles centered on TypeScript, Node.js, and web technologies; while they have diverse experience and open-source contributions, there is minimal evidence of leadership in cloud compute systems or C++-centric distributed infrastructure as mandated.
strengths: Strong full-stack and cross-platform development experience across multiple languages and domains
Demonstrated leadership in open-source projects and technical mentoring through workshops and talks
Proven ability to build and deploy scalable systems using Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD practices
concerns: Only 1-2 years of C++ experience (LabWindows/CVI role), far below the 8-year minimum requirement
No clear evidence of cloud compute platform leadership or large-scale distributed systems design
Primary tech stack is JavaScript/TypeScript, with no demonstrated ownership of cloud infrastructure or hardware-adjacent compute architecture
